archimate:Outcome.name: Reduced Out-of-Pocket Expenditure for Eligible Groups
archimate:Outcome.documentation:
This represents a significant reduction in errors when identifying beneficiaries for health subsidies or social protection. It ensures that the digital identification of vulnerable groups is both precise and inclusive.
The purpose is to ensure that limited public resources are directed to those with the greatest need while preventing the misuse of funds by non-eligible parties. It enhances the social equity of the health financing system by reaching marginalized populations accurately.
Example: Using cross-referenced social registry data to identify and enroll low-income families who were previously missed by manual outreach.
